endcard: Save this for your darkest night

save.ar:
لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ
إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
save.tr: “There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.”

lines.say: Three layers of darkness. One sentence. And Allah answered.
Swallowed by the fish, in the dark of the night and the sea, Prophet Yunus, peace be upon him, called out:
lines.cap: The night. The sea. The belly of the fish.

lines.say: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.
lines.cap: “And thus do We save the believers.”

lines.say: Ibn Kathir explains: this is for believers who call on Allah and turn to Him in distress.
lines.cap: For every believer who calls on Allah in distress.

lines.say: Whatever darkness you are in tonight, you know the words now.
lines.cap: Whatever darkness you’re in tonight, you know the words now.

lines.say: Save this, and send it to someone going through a hard time.
lines.cap: Save this & send it to someone who needs it 🤍

v1.ar:
فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ
سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
v1.tr: “And he called out within the darknesses, ‘There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.’”

v2.ar:
فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ ۚ
وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
v2.tr: “So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.”
